title: Code and artifacts for Record-Level Evaluation of a Morlet CNN-Conformer for Five-Class ECG Beat Classification
description: Source code, fixed experiment configurations, trained models, and prediction arrays supporting a record-level evaluation of four ECG heartbeat classifiers on the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database.
